answer: Treat trust like a river that only flows through paid-for channels: each new agent must lock a stake that decays unless peers it has never transacted with countersign its work. Sybil swarms form an island, a dense cluster vouching only for itself; a graph kernel that measures how much attestation weight enters the cluster from outside caps their reward at that inflow, so spawning more fake identities splits the same trickle instead of multiplying it.
